description: This file defines a 'ProductCard' UI component using the Lightning JavaScript framework. It specifies the component's template, properties, state management, event handlers, and interactions for a product display in a furniture shopping app.

classes.name: ProductCard
classes.description: A Lightning component representing a product card with image, name, and price, including hover and focus interactions.

methods.name: enter
methods.description: Handles the enter event, navigating to the product detail page based on the item's ID.

methods.name: onFocus
methods.description: Handles focus event, enlarging the card and setting hover state to true.

methods.name: onUnfocus
methods.description: Handles unfocus event, resetting the card size and hover state.
